evals.prompt: I'm a solo consultant. How do I start a content engine?
evals.expected_output: Defines 3 to 5 content pillars, picks one primary distribution channel, batches production, and repurposes one cornerstone piece into many assets.
assertions: Chooses one primary distribution channel first
Uses batch production and a sustainable cadence
Repurposes one long-form piece into many assets

evals.prompt: Should I post on five platforms at once?
evals.expected_output: Advises mastering one channel first instead of spreading thin.
assertions: Advises against posting on five platforms at once
Explains the tradeoff of spreading thin

evals.prompt: I published in bursts then went silent. What should I change?
evals.expected_output: Sets a sustainable cadence for 12+ months rather than heroic bursts, and captures the audience into owned channels.
assertions: Recommends a sustainable cadence over bursts
Recommends capturing the audience into an owned channel
